tells.1: Every bullet ends in a tidy 'so you can/so your PT can' justification, which feels a little templated
tells.3: Over-friendly filler that tries too hard to sound casual ('Maybe you're bouncing back,' 'keep you moving forward,' 'get moving')
tells.4: Flattened, stripped tone plus the vague 'unlocks additional features'; it reads like an over-corrected rewrite
tells.5: Generic marketing phrases ('guidance you can trust,' 'keep your recovery moving,' 'unlock more of what the app has to offer')

reason: Version 2 has the slightly clunky, exclamation-marked quality of real app-store copy, but its subscription wording is awkward. Version 1 keeps the same plain facts, cleans up the language and the legal text, and avoids the empty marketing phrases in versions 3 and 5, so it's the best one to publish.
